source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 모두 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Freeze an independent Arm A photographic concept before any downstream data is consulted, using the supplied portrait only as visible adult appearance guidance and making a complex but physically credible optical event traceable across the person and several connected environmental surfaces for later rendered-image evaluation.
subject: Exactly one clearly adult fictional person with long dark softly wavy hair, a near-center part, a few fine loose strands, dark eyes, a calm closed-mouth expression, and a steady direct gaze. The adult wears a matte black lightweight V-neck blouse, charcoal high-waisted trousers, weathered dark ankle boots, and a fine short gold-tone necklace with a tiny central detail, standing in a stable three-quarter stance with one hand turning a waist-height brass handwheel and the other bracing its circular frame. The supplied image guides only these visible appearance cues.
setting: A disused circular coastal-lighthouse lens-servicing gallery immediately after a rain squall, with a narrow high east-facing window, an aged curved wall of off-white glazed tiles, a waist-high brass carriage supporting a large segmented Fresnel lens and perforated brass safety screen, an iron spiral-stair rail at the edge, and a rain-darkened gray stone floor carrying a shallow irregular water film. The window and optical assembly occupy upper left, the adult stands near center, and broad wet floor extends into the lower-right foreground.
event: Hard low sunrise passes through the visible segmented Fresnel lens and then the perforated brass safety screen, forming one coherent diagonal rainbow-tinted oval lattice. The same projection begins on the curved tiled wall, crosses the adult's hair, one cheek, collarbone, black blouse, forearm, and wheel hand, continues over the brass carriage edge, and stretches onto the wet stone floor. Its direction, oval rhythm, and spectral order stay consistent while spacing and shape bend with each receiving plane, disappear at opaque occlusions, and resume only where the beam can physically reach.
visual_priorities: Make the first-read event one coherent diagonal prismatic oval lattice whose path is visibly traceable from the curved wall across the adult and brass carriage to the wet floor.
Show aligned colored openings and dark interruptions crossing the adult's hair, cheek, neckline, blouse, forearm, and hand rather than confining the projection to the background.
Keep the sunlit high window, segmented Fresnel lens, perforated brass screen, receiving wall, adult, carriage, and floor continuation legible in one frame so the optical cause is self-evident.

Preserve physically consistent deformation: compression on the curved tile, contour-following light on skin and matte fabric, restrained brass highlights, and an elongated brighter continuation over the thin water film.
Keep the single adult's direct gaze, handwheel action, both hands, and referenced visible appearance readable within a three-quarter-length environmental portrait.

Render the scene as a physically photographed moment with coherent shadow direction, realistic exposure rolloff, natural material texture, restrained prismatic color, architectural depth, and fine color-negative grain.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical 4:5 environmental portrait inside a disused circular coastal-lighthouse lens-servicing gallery just after a rain squall. Show exactly one clearly adult person; treat the person as an original fictional adult and use the supplied reference only for visible appearance: long dark softly wavy hair with a near-center part and a few fine loose strands, dark eyes, a calm closed-mouth expression and steady direct gaze, a matte black lightweight V-neck blouse, and a fine short gold-tone necklace with a tiny central detail. Add charcoal high-waisted trousers and weathered dark ankle boots. The adult stands naturally beside a waist-high brass carriage holding a large segmented Fresnel lens, one hand firmly turning its handwheel and the other lightly bracing the circular frame, with both hands anatomically clear. A hard low sunrise beam enters through a narrow high east-facing window at upper left, passes through the visibly illuminated Fresnel lens, then through a clearly visible perforated brass safety screen. It creates one broad diagonal rainbow-tinted oval lattice as the unmistakable first-read event. Show that same projection beginning on the curved aged off-white glazed-tile wall, bending and compressing with the wall, then crossing the adult through aligned colored openings and dark oval interruptions over hair, one cheek, collarbone, blouse, forearm, and wheel hand. Continue it over the near edge of the brass carriage and stretch it in perspective across a shallow rainwater film on the gray stone floor toward lower right. Maintain one projection direction, repeating oval rhythm, and consistent spectral order while its geometry conforms to wall, face, fabric, metal, and wet floor; opaque occlusions interrupt it naturally. Keep the illuminated window, lens segments, screen, wall segment, adult, handwheel, and floor continuation visible together. Frame from waist height with a full-frame 35 mm viewpoint about 2.8 meters away, slightly right of the optical axis with a gentle downward tilt, a three-quarter-length adult slightly right of center, the apparatus in the upper-left third, and broad wet floor in the lower-right foreground. Use moderate depth of field around f/5.6. Balance hard warm refracted sunrise against cool blue-gray room ambience about two stops darker. Preserve realistic skin, matte fabric, curved tile, tarnished brass, salt residue, damp footprints, coherent shadow direction, gentle highlight rolloff, restrained spectral color, and fine 35 mm color-negative grain. The photograph has quiet cinematic documentary realism with restrained fashion-editorial precision.
